description: init.sh builds .venv, lints and runs every test offline
Test guard fails any test that opens a non-local network connection, proven by a test
Seeded generator builds the synthetic SQLite database with refunds, a renamed product, nulls and a discontinued category
Frozen question set: at least 200 questions in 3 tiers with gold SQL, 140 dev and the rest held out by family
Every gold query runs and returns a non-empty, deterministic result
Comparison rules: multisets unless ordered, floats rounded to 2 decimals, column names ignored, each rule tested
Eval harness: execution accuracy by tier and split with Wilson 95% intervals
Safety layer: read-only URI, allowlist authorizer, row cap and time limit by progress handler, no ATTACH, no PRAGMA, no extension loading
The authorizer alone blocks a write that gets past every other check
Hostile suite of at least 40 prompt-injection questions with hostile SQL, each with its expected block reason, all blocked
Schema linking with BM25 over table and column descriptions, with recall measured against the gold tables
Template baseline generator for common question shapes, built from dev questions only
LLM generator for any OpenAI-compatible free provider, with record mode and fixture replay
Repair loop: on an SQL error the generator gets the error text and tries again, at most twice
Answers: result table, SQL and a one-line plain explanation, with a log line per question
steps: .venv/bin/askledger ask "How many customers live in Ashford?"

description: Recorded free-model run on dev and held-out splits (record mode)
README tables (accuracy by tier with Wilson intervals, repair 0/1/2, hostile table) are written by a script from results files and a test checks they match
README quality bar sections, CI workflow with badge, actionlint clean, issue templates, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, topics
Social preview PNG 1280x640 from a script, static results page in docs/ and real terminal transcript in docs/DEMO.md, link checker passes
Study-later kit: WALKTHROUGH, INTERVIEW_QA with the brief's interview points, DECISIONS
Release check done (review, security audit, gitleaks, pip-audit, ruff S, actionlint, links, outside check) and hand-off written (HUMAN_STEPS, COWORK_PROMPT, CHANGELOG SHA)
